name: Doi Begun
steps: Cut brinjal into thick slices and pat dry. Rub with half the turmeric and salt.
Pan-fry brinjal in most of the oil for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and tender; remove to a plate.
Whisk curd with measured water and the listed ground spices until completely smooth.
Add cumin and any listed whole spices to the remaining oil over medium heat. Lower heat and add the curd mixture gradually, stirring continuously until gently simmering.
Add the remaining salt and sugar if listed. Simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring the base; do not let the yoghurt sauce boil vigorously.
Return the fried brinjal to the sauce and simmer very gently for 5 minutes without breaking the slices.
tips: Simmer gently, stir the base regularly and check the main ingredient is tender before finishing the gravy.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
